title: Maria S Possible NDE 6145
content: I was lying on my back in a cot. I knew that I shouldn't lie flat or on my back because of the sleep apnea. I told myself that I would only take a short nap, and not allow myself to drift off because I had been out of my body before and did not want to go again, as I had three small children to raise (please forgive my typing abilities). Anyway, I'm lying in the cot and I start hearing an 'electrical' buzzing sound and begin to feel heavy as lead. At this point, I know there is no turning back, because this sound along with feeling heavy as lead has always preceded previous out of body experiences. I think to myself, 'Oh no here you go again, you shouldn't be doing this.' Then, without even any sensation of coming out of my body, I am floating in a grey mist. This grey mist is a neutral zone as much as I could tell. My form is now spherical with a small sphere on top, which is my head. This sphere (that I am) is made of soft greyish blue light. I'm just floating there in a grey mist, thinking 'now what?', and 'will I be able to get back?' Then floating down from my above right comes a... so hard to describe, but here goes: A light formed as the finest confetti, and every piece of the confetti is light, love, the most peaceful loving music I have ever heard, and everything that is good. All this came down through me. But I knew that I must not stay, even though I could easily want to. I thought to myself 'I can't stay; I have to raise my three children.' At that point, nothing changed. Then I decided to pray. I said 'Our Father...' The first word was not all the way said, and in less than a second I was back in my body.

out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Heard an 'electrical' buzzing sound and felt 'heavy as lead' before finding herself floating in a grey mist; she reports 'without even any sensation of coming out of my body'.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Sleep apnea while lying on her back to nap.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Pre-OBE 'electrical' buzzing and heaviness; grey mist 'neutral zone'; confetti-like light/love/music passing through her; immediate return upon starting the 'Our Father' prayer.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE into grey mist without tunnel; light phenomenon occurred in the mist; return followed her decision to pray.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Self described as a spherical form of 'soft greyish blue light' with a smaller sphere on top as the head; light described as 'the finest confetti' where each piece was 'light, love, the most peaceful loving music'.

The first word was not all the way said, and in less than a second I was back in my body.”
